mapper.sql: working_time_missions.id AS id, DATE_FORMAT(working_time_missions.date_from, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(working_time_missions.date_to, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, working_time_missions.description AS description, working_time_missions.working_time_id AS workingTimeId, working_times.is_close AS status, working_times.created AS created, working_times.modified AS modified, CONCAT(IFNULL(user1.first_name,''), ' ', IFNULL(user1.last_name,'')) AS createdBy, CONCAT(IFNULL(user2.first_name,''), ' ', IFNULL(user2.last_name,'')) AS modifiedBy

FROM working_time_missions JOIN working_times ON working_time_missions.working_time_id = working_times.id LEFT JOIN users AS user1 ON working_times.created_by = user1.id LEFT JOIN users AS user2 ON working_times.modified_by = user2.id

WHERE working_time_missions.is_active = 1 AND working_times.type = 2
AND ( (DATE(working_time_missions.date_from) >= #{filter.startDate} AND DATE(working_time_missions.date_from) <= #{filter.endDate}) OR (DATE(working_time_missions.date_to) >= #{filter.startDate} AND DATE(working_time_missions.date_to) <= #{filter.endDate}) )
AND working_times.is_close = #{filter.status}
AND working_time_missions.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO working_times ( company_id, description, type, is_close, is_active, created, created_by ) VALUES ( 1, #{description}, 2, 0, 1, NOW(), #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO working_time_missions ( working_time_id, date_from, date_to, description, is_active, created, created_by, modified, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{mission.workingTimeId}, #{mission.startDate}, #{mission.endDate}, #{mission.description}, 1, NOW(), #{mission.createdBy}, NOW()NULL, #{mission.modifiedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE working_time_missions JOIN working_times ON working_time_missions.working_time_id = working_times.id SET working_time_missions.is_active = 2, working_time_missions.modified = NOW(), working_time_missions.modified_by = #{userId}, working_times.is_active = 2, working_times.modified = NOW(), working_times.modified_by = #{userId} WHERE working_time_missions.id = #{id}

UPDATE working_time_missions SET description = #{mission.description}, date_from = #{mission.startDate}, date_to = #{mission.endDate}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{mission.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{mission.id}

UPDATE working_times JOIN working_time_missions ON working_time_missions.working_time_id = working_times.id SET working_times.is_close = #{mission.status}, working_times.modified = NOW(), working_times.modified_by = #{mission.modifiedBy} WHERE working_time_missions.id = #{mission.id}
mapper.select: SELECT working_time_means.id AS id, working_time_means.description AS name FROM working_time_mission_means JOIN working_time_means ON working_time_mission_means.working_time_mean_id = working_time_means.id WHERE working_time_mission_means.working_time_mission_id = #{missionId}

SELECT customers.id AS id, customers.name AS name FROM working_time_organizations JOIN customers ON working_time_organizations.organization_id = customers.id WHERE working_time_organizations.working_time_id = #{missionId}

SELECT working_time_destinations.id AS id, working_time_destinations.description AS name FROM working_time_mission_destinations JOIN working_time_destinations ON working_time_mission_destinations.working_time_destination_id = working_time_destinations.id WHERE working_time_mission_destinations.working_time_mission_id = #{missionId}
